records.name: Finance department access
records.content:
# Uses department attributes currently mapped by demo_ldap.
define AccountingStaff as a device with demo.department:Accounting.
define FinanceStaff as a device with demo.department:Finance.
define PayrollStaff as a device with demo.department:Payroll.
define FinanceWorkspace as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:finance-workspace.
define PayrollRecords as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:payroll-records.

service FinanceWorkspace as json {"service_class":"FinanceWorkspace","actor_cn":"finance-workspace","summary":"Illustrative finance reporting and ledger workspace.","endpoint":"zpr://finance-workspace","status":"example only; not deployed"}.

service PayrollRecords as json {"service_class":"PayrollRecords","actor_cn":"payroll-records","summary":"Illustrative payroll records service.","endpoint":"zpr://payroll-records","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow AccountingStaff.
  allow FinanceStaff.
  allow PayrollStaff.
records.summary: Department-based finance workspace and payroll access

records.name: Engineering build access
records.content:
# Platform and Product map to LDAP organizational-unit values.
define PlatformStaff as a device with demo.department:Platform.
define ProductStaff as a device with demo.department:Product.
define EngineeringBuildFarm as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:engineering-build.

service EngineeringBuildFarm as json {"service_class":"EngineeringBuildFarm","actor_cn":"engineering-build","summary":"Illustrative build and release system.","endpoint":"zpr://engineering-build","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow PlatformStaff.
  allow ProductStaff.
records.summary: Platform and Product access to the illustrative build farm

records.name: Security and compliance access
records.content:
# Department-based security and compliance policy.
define SecurityStaff as a device with demo.department:Security.
define ComplianceStaff as a device with demo.department:Compliance.
define SecurityIncidentConsole as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:security-console.

service SecurityIncidentConsole as json {"service_class":"SecurityIncidentConsole","actor_cn":"security-console","summary":"Illustrative incident response and review console.","endpoint":"zpr://security-console","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow SecurityStaff.
  allow ComplianceStaff.

records.name: Security role-group access
records.content:
# These predicates use LDAP groupOfNames memberships on the authenticated user.
define IncidentResponders as a user with user.role:'Incident Responder'.
define SecurityReviewers as a user with user.role:'Security Reviewer'.
define Approvers as a user with user.role:Approver.
define SecurityIncidentConsole as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:security-console.

service SecurityIncidentConsole as json {"service_class":"SecurityIncidentConsole","actor_cn":"security-console","summary":"Illustrative incident response and review console.","endpoint":"zpr://security-console","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow IncidentResponders.
  allow SecurityReviewers.
  allow Approvers.
records.summary: Role-group access to the illustrative security console

records.name: Sales and customer success access
records.content:
# Customer Success is quoted because its LDAP value contains a space.
define FieldSales as a device with demo.department:Field.
define CustomerSuccess as a device with demo.department:'Customer Success'.
define SalesCRM as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:sales-crm.

service SalesCRM as json {"service_class":"SalesCRM","actor_cn":"sales-crm","summary":"Illustrative account and customer success workspace.","endpoint":"zpr://sales-crm","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow FieldSales.
  allow CustomerSuccess.
records.summary: Field and Customer Success access to the illustrative CRM

records.name: Secure device posture
records.content:
# Machine posture comes from the LDAP zprMachine schema.
define Laptops as a device with demo.machine_type:laptop.
define NorthCampusDevices as a device with demo.location:'North Campus'.
define SecureDevices as a device with demo.secure:TRUE.
define SecureDeviceOperations as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:secure-device-operations.

service SecureDeviceOperations as json {"service_class":"SecureDeviceOperations","actor_cn":"secure-device-operations","summary":"Illustrative posture-gated device operations.","endpoint":"zpr://secure-device-operations","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow SecureDevices.
records.summary: Device type, location, and secure status predicates

records.name: User department and role access
records.content:
# User fields and group roles require an authenticated user.sub identity.
define FinanceUsers as a user with user.department:Finance.
define SecurityReviewers as a user with user.role:'Security Reviewer'.
define UserRecords as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:user-records.

service UserRecords as json {"service_class":"UserRecords","actor_cn":"user-records","summary":"Illustrative user-scoped records.","endpoint":"zpr://user-records","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
  allow FinanceUsers.
  allow SecurityReviewers.
records.summary: User LDAP profile and group-role predicates
